name: Telegram Bot Message
description: Send a scheduled message to a Telegram chat through the Bot API with a single HTTPS request, for people who already live in Telegram rather than Slack, Discord or ntfy.

parameters.label: Bot token
parameters.help: The token BotFather gave you when you created the bot. It is stored in the task and visible in its command line, so use a bot made only for this. The curl tool must be installed.

parameters.label: Chat ID
parameters.help: The numeric ID of the chat to message. Send your bot a message first, then read the ID from the getUpdates method of the Bot API.

parameters.label: Message
parameters.help: The notification text. Avoid double quotes in it.
